items.title: Integral closure commutes with smooth pullback for algebraic spaces
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For a smooth morphism of algebraic spaces over a scheme and a quasi-coherent sheaf of algebras on the target, the lemma shows that forming the integral closure commutes with the smooth base change. The proof reduces to the schemes case through an etale chart, using that both the integral closure and smoothness are compatible with etale localisation, and then transports the identification back. The reduction through the chart is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 6131-6160.
